import pytest

from date_utils import days_in_month


def test_days_in_month_all_months_non_leap():
    non_leap_years = [2023, 2021, 1900]
    for year in non_leap_years:
        assert days_in_month(year, 1) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 2) == 28
        assert days_in_month(year, 3) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 4) == 30
        assert days_in_month(year, 5) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 6) == 30
        assert days_in_month(year, 7) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 8) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 9) == 30
        assert days_in_month(year, 10) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 11) == 30
        assert days_in_month(year, 12) == 31


def test_days_in_month_all_months_leap():
    leap_years = [2024, 2020, 2000]
    for year in leap_years:
        assert days_in_month(year, 1) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 2) == 29
        assert days_in_month(year, 3) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 4) == 30
        assert days_in_month(year, 5) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 6) == 30
        assert days_in_month(year, 7) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 8) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 9) == 30
        assert days_in_month(year, 10) == 31
        assert days_in_month(year, 11) == 30
        assert days_in_month(year, 12) == 31


def test_days_in_month_edge_year():
    assert days_in_month(1, 1) == 31
    assert days_in_month(9999, 12) == 31


def test_days_in_month_invalid_month_zero():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="month must be in 1..12"):
        days_in_month(2023, 0)


def test_days_in_month_invalid_month_13():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="month must be in 1..12"):
        days_in_month(2023, 13)

import pytest

from validators import validate_port


def test_port_exact_boundary_values():
    assert validate_port(1) == 1
    assert validate_port(65535) == 65535


def test_port_rejects_zero():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_port(0)


def test_port_rejects_negative():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_port(-1)


def test_port_rejects_bool():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_port(True)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_port(False)


def test_port_rejects_float():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_port(8080.5)

import pytest
from validators import validate_port


def test_validate_port_valid_boundary_low():
    """Test port 1, the minimum valid port."""
    assert validate_port(1) == 1


def test_validate_port_valid_boundary_high():
    """Test port 65535, the maximum valid port."""
    assert validate_port(65535) == 65535


def test_validate_port_valid_middle():
    """Test a port in the middle of the valid range."""
    assert validate_port(32768) == 32768


def test_validate_port_bool_rejected():
    """Test that bool inputs raise ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port must be an integer"):
        validate_port(True)


def test_validate_port_non_int_rejected():
    """Test that non-int inputs raise ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port must be an integer"):
        validate_port("123")


def test_validate_port_out_of_range_low():
    """Test port 0, which is out of range."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port out of range"):
        validate_port(0)


def test_validate_port_out_of_range_high():
    """Test port 65536, which is out of range."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port out of range"):
        validate_port(65536)
